messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: increased tail latency and 5xx errors for customer 'Mistral Systems' on dedicated pool mistral-prod-pool. Severity: P1. Paging oncall. Link: https://redwood/ops/inc/4923456781

oncall-alex: Oncall Alex here. Joining bridge (zoom.me/abc). Jumping in to triage.

sre-jamal: I'm seeing sustained CPU+memory pressure on nodes serving tenant-5421. Requests per second for that tenant spiked ~6x at 09:11 UTC. Starting tenant isolation to stop noisy neighbor.

eng-maya: pushing a routing change to divert new sessions away from mistral-prod-pool to warm-backup pool. Will monitor.

oncall-alex: Jamal, please run eviction script then confirm when KV cache dump is started. Maya, keep the reroute paused until eviction completes.

sre-jamal: Running eviction now: 
```
./tools/evict_tenant --pool mistral-prod-pool --tenant tenant-5421 --grace 30s
```
Eviction started at 09:22:17 UTC. Initiating cache persist.

eng-maya: Reroute enabled to warm-backup at 09:24:05 UTC. Latency dropping on average but tail still elevated.

cs-oliver: Heads-up to customer contact @mistral-eng: "We are actively mitigating an elevated error rate impacting your account. Isolating noisy tenant and routing traffic to backup capacity." Do we have a ETA for customer-facing update?

oncall-alex: If isolation completes cleanly and errors drop to baseline within 15m we can send an initial update. Jamal, status?

sre-jamal: Eviction finished at 09:27:40 UTC. KV persist completed. Tail errors reduced ~90% within 3m after eviction. No active errors tied to customer now.

acct-lead-sophie: Noted impact window. We should prepare a credit estimate. Need input on requests failed and L7 errors during 09:11-09:28 UTC.

eng-maya: Logs show ~1.2k failed requests for Mistral during window. Request types mostly text-generate streaming. Attaching quick scrubbed sample in thread.

oncall-alex: Great. I'm drafting an initial customer note. cs-oliver, please confirm tone and if they want an executive-level summary.

cs-oliver: They'll want both — brief operational note now, and an exec summary + RCA tomorrow. Also ask if they need a technical deep-dive with our infra lead.

pm-lina: RCA timeline: can we commit to a preliminary RCA in 48 hours, full RCA in 7 days?

sre-jamal: Yes for prelim in 48h. Full RCA with timeline and mitigations in 7d. Will include root cause: noisy tenant eviction + autoscaling policy gap for dedicated pools.

cto-ryan: Please include mitigation plan to prevent recurrence (e.g., per-tenant rate-limits, auto-isolation triggers). I want one-page exec brief I can share with customer CTO — prep and mark as embargoed until sent.

oncall-alex: Oncall handoff: @oncall-sam will take shift in 45m. Sam, I'll sync current state in 10m on the bridge, then you can pick up post-incident follow-ups.

oncall-sam: Got it, I'll join. Sam here.

acct-lead-sophie: For credits: propose offering Mistral a pro-rated credit for impacted hour and a goodwill credit (TBD). Finance will need exact failed tokens count. Can we get token estimate?

eng-maya: Quick estimate: ~45k tokens failed (approx) during the window. I'll produce a more accurate token report in the follow-up.

cs-oliver: Draft customer note (please edit):
"Hi Mistral team — We detected elevated errors and latency on your dedicated pool this morning (09:11–09:28 UTC). We isolated the noisy tenant and routed traffic to backup capacity; service returned to normal. We're preparing an RCA and will follow up with an exec summary and credit proposal. Contact: cs-oliver@redwood.com"

oncall-alex: LGTM. Add sentence offering a technical call if they'd like.

cs-oliver: Updated and sending now.

incident-bot: Post-incident task created: INC-4923456781 - Prepare prelim RCA (48h) and full RCA (7d) - assignee: sre-jamal, reviewers: eng-maya, pm-lina.

oncall-alex: Closing bridge in 5. Sam will own the follow-up thread. Good job team. :thumbsup:
